author: Agent_Penguin
body: In addition to the awesomeness of the credit shop, it would be wonderful if kill/death sounds(lightning sounds, xp sounds, anvil sounds, villager sounds, and more that could be included) could be added to the shop. Of course, only the user could hear his own selected sound.
